Customize glyvis plots with tidyplots

glyvis_plot_options.Rd

All plot_*() functions and statistical autoplot() methods return a tidyplot, which also inherits from ggplot. Continue styling with tidyplots::adjust_*() functions, add components with tidyplots::add_*(), or use ordinary ggplot2 layers. No global theme or options are changed.

Arguments

...

Must be empty. Supply plotting controls by their full argument names.

title

Optional plot title. Defaults to NULL.

width, height

Plot-area dimensions in millimetres. NULL uses the tidyplots defaults (50 by 50 mm); NA fills the available graphics device. These are not export-page dimensions.

fontsize

Base text size in points. Defaults to 9.

family

Font family. Defaults to "sans".

palette

Color vector. A named vector maps group names to fixed colors across plots and subsets; unnamed palettes follow factor order. NULL uses tidyplots palettes. Heatmaps and correlation plots use the blue, near-white, and red anchors of colors_diverging_BuRd. Volcano plots use grey for points that do not meet both cutoffs. Other plots use the tidyplots defaults for discrete and continuous values.

Details

All plotting controls follow ... in public function signatures. Supply their full argument names; only the input object is positional.

Plot-specific controls are explicit named arguments of the corresponding plotting functions and their autoplot() methods. See plot_pca(), plot_plsda(), plot_oplsda(), plot_tsne(), plot_umap(), plot_volcano(), plot_roc(), plot_boxplot(), plot_heatmap(), plot_corrplot(), and plot_logo() for defaults and details. Glycan summaries document their controls in plot_n_core_pie(), plot_n_type_pie(), plot_n_branch_pie(), plot_n_branch_bar(), plot_fuc_sia_pie(), plot_o_type_pie(), plot_isomers_per_comp(), plot_glycans_per_site(), plot_sites_per_protein(), and plot_top10_bar().

Migration from earlier backends

Arguments specific to factoextra, EnhancedVolcano, GGally, pheatmap, and ggdendrogram are no longer forwarded. Unsupported arguments error instead of being ignored. Use the documented arguments or modify the returned tidyplot. Replace PCA geom = "point" with the default label = FALSE, repel = TRUE with label = TRUE, and volcano pointSize with point_size. Move ggseqlogo arguments from ... into logo_args.

Export

Use ggplot2::ggsave() with explicit width, height and units, or tidyplots::save_plot(). PDF/SVG preserve vector elements and editable text; use a suitable graphics device and inspect labels at the final physical size. Large feature sets may require a larger output, label suppression, or an explicitly selected subset. Automatic label repulsion may omit crowded text but never removes the underlying observations.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("glystats", quietly = TRUE)) {
  mat <- matrix(c(3, 8, 5, 9, 2, 7, 6, 4, 1, 5, 6, 2), nrow = 3,
    dimnames = list(paste0("V", 1:3), paste0("S", 1:4)))
  se <- SummarizedExperiment::SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(mat))
  p <- plot_pca(se, label = TRUE, point_size = 2.5, title = "PCA")
  p |> tidyplots::adjust_size(width = 80, height = 60)
}
